digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: External integration tests run only against Anthropic provider, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetectable by CI automation
Provider selection is an ambient default rather than an explicit matrix dimension, preventing live-grounded confidence across all credentialed providers
Config overlay mechanism must set only [llm.model_classes] via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE to ensure provider switching does not depend on deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials rather than EC2 instance role, with explicit AWS region configuration to prevent NoRegionError
Missing provider credentials must result in loud, visible skips distinguishable from passing runs, never silent fallback or ambiguous green status
